'''Impedance''' is a [[debuff]] which applies a flaming horned skull effect to the player's head. It is applied during the countdown in {{il|Oba's Cursed Trove}}. After the countdown in chat reaches 0, the player's head visually explodes and kills the player. The debuff itself does not provide any negative effects otherwise.
